_meta.note: intermittent 503 and a one-time 'Один момент...' interstitial seen on www.loc.gov (rate limiting); retried successfully. curl gets 403, browser OK.

stack: Custom Django-ish app (loc.gov), two UI generations: home + new templates = 'ui2' Bootstrap 5.3 (--bs-* vars, data-bs-theme=dark on <html>, htmx, Splide carousels, Fancybox (--f-button-*), FontAwesome 6, 291 CSS vars on :root); inner pages (search/item/collection/resource) still old /static/stylesheets/base.css. jQuery 1.8.2 + OpenSeadragon 2.3.1 on all pages. Adobe DTM/AppMeasurement analytics.
iiif: IIIF Image API on tile.loc.gov: https://tile.loc.gov/image-services/iiif/service:gmd:gmd370:g3700:g3700:cw0012700/info.json ; tiles via .../0,0,8192,8192/512,/0/default.jpg (width-only size) ; viewer only at /resource/<id>/ pages, item page shows image + 'View Enlarged Image' button + 'Download: JPEG (1060x1422px)' select

fonts.body: Open Sans 400/700 (+italics) -> https://www.loc.gov/static/ui2/dist/css/OpenSans-Regular.woff2 (verified 200; same dir for Bold/Italic)

home_ui2.card title: 1rem bold, label .8125rem bold, list card title 1.125rem

palette.accent/orange: #f05129 = rgb(240,81,41), 4px top stripe on inner pages; also --bs-accent-text-emphasis
palette.gold-stripe-home-dark: top stripe on dark home is gold (shots/loc/home-desktop.png); rgb(250,172,29) found once among colors, not confirmed as stripe

layout.container: ui2 max 1320px (xxl), inner pages 1144px content inside 1200px max
layout.header: home 135px dark, inner 145px (140 + 4px orange stripe); not sticky; search form 509px wide x 32px (select 190px 'Everything' + input 278px + 39px black button) with 1px black border, no radius
layout.search_results: sidebar facets 265px + results column 851px, gap 27px; item row padding 21px 0, thumb 200x200 contain, hairline separators
layout.viewer: OSD container 675px high on black, toolbar top-right 6 square 38px buttons (home/zoom out/zoom in/rotate/fullscreen/crop) white outline on black, tab 'Image' blue (hex not measured)
layout.carousel: rotating featured banner 1200x560 (xl 851x287) with splide arrows 2.5rem and pause button

animations: spinner 2s
mejs loading spinner

dark_theme: yes: data-bs-theme=dark on home; theme toggle icons sun/moon/circle-half-stroke defined in icon vars

cssVars.--bs-font-monospace: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
